disclaimer: sourceText is quoted or lightly trimmed from public ClinicalTrials.gov eligibility language, or from the structured minimumAge/maximumAge field in the same pull. Attribute those records to ClinicalTrials.gov. These labels were written before any parser call on this held-out set.
labelingNotes: Ten recruiting regional stage III/IV NSCLC trials from data/ctgov/region-trials.json, none of which are in the original 9-trial gold set or the three prompt-v2/v3 few-shots.
Labels cover key typed criteria only. Subjective items (measurable disease/RECIST, life expectancy, investigator judgment, 'adequate organ function' without a number) were not labeled as typed gold.
Where the eligibility text had no age sentence, age_min 18 was taken from the structured minimumAge field that the parser also receives.

PD-L1 cutoffs were labeled only when the eligibility text stated a numeric threshold, not from a title alone (NCT06868277 title says PD-L1-high, but the pulled eligibility text has no cutoff, so no pdl1_min item).
Compound OR rules that are not a simple typed value (for example PD-L1 <1% OR STK11 mutation on NCT05098132) were not forced into a typed kind.
Part-dependent prior-line rules on NCT06772623 were not labeled as typed.
These labels will not be changed after the parser is run in this pass, and postprocess rules will not be tuned on this set in this pass.
